what: The background is one sheet drawn by a shader with three blurred apricot discs and one white bloom — the discs are white at the center (1 → .7 up to half the diameter, 0 at the end) and their edges blur with a 400px blur (×1.2) based on the short side, and only where the lens passes does the edge melt at ±.6 width and glow big (×1.5). The lens orbits the discs’ center of gravity (closer discs weigh more) once per 5s at a radius of 20% of the short side, is pulled toward the mouse by .3 (up to .95 on wider landscape screens), and both discs and lens follow late with damping 8. On scroll, the discs rise .5× and the white bloom 1.25×, and 1.35px grain (±.04) simmers. If each page gives a spot with fx:orbs, they slide to that spot, and a disc appearing at diameter 0 grows in place.

options.turn: Seconds for the lens to make one turn, default 5
options.pull: Share pulled toward the mouse (more toward .95 on screens wider than a 1.2 ratio), default .3
options.soft: Disc blur (px, divided by short side and pixel ratio), default 400
options.grain: Grain amount, default .04 — 0 turns it off
options.scroll: Scroll parallax (disc), default .5 — 0 keeps it fixed
options.sp: Max width (px) at which the phone slot (sp) is used, default 766.98
options.data-orbs: JSON in the element’s data-orbs — {"pc":[{x,y,size,opacity?,gradient?:"left|right",lensWeight?}×4], "sp":[…]} Or a single array. x and y are the disc’s top-left, size is the diameter (all as a share of screen width). The fourth is a white blur
options.fx:orbs: On the element, CustomEvent(detail = Same Type as above) — swap positions when turning the page
options.fx:motion: detail { reduce: true|false } — ‹Pause motion› button. When paused, lens, grain and blur turn off, leaving a crisp disc
options.fx:theme: Re-read colors after swapping the Skin
options.--fx-orb-base · --fx-orb-tint · --fx-orb: Background · disc · white-light colors, default var(--kf-bg) · var(--kf-accent-soft) · var(--kf-surface)

note: The CommonJS build of three (three.cjs) loads _fx/pillar-gallery-gl/three-global.js first and is used as window.THREE. The shaders are not ported from the original but newly written with the same values (blur 400 per short side · lens .35 · edge .6 · falloff 8 · 5s rotation · grain .04/1.35px · parallax .5/2.5). Colors are output as raw sRGB numbers (the original does no linear conversion, so my peach #ffe7d1 appears as #ffcca3 — set the skin’s accent-soft to the visible color).

from.where: shared.js .gf-bg — a background that moves the disc position on every page
